description: Programme for rebuilding the religious places affected by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been reported that 758 Buddhist temples, 272 Hindu religious places, 199 Muslim religious places and 99 Christian religious places have been exposed to various disasters due to the cyclone 'Ditwah'. Measures have been taken to carry out renovation work at 256 religious places from among them by utilizing funds of Rs. 929.69 million allocated by the Buddhasasana Fund, the Central Cultural Fund and the Anagarika Dharmapala Foundation, including Rs.329.62 million allocated as per the Cabinet decisions dated 2026-04-27 and 2026-06-15. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to renovate another 144 religious places out of remaining religious places that have been damaged, using provisions of Rs.232.07 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
